answer: Registration mints a "comet" ticket: one proof-of-work plus a seed, and every later credit to that address must cite it. Fake identities aren't banned, just starved: their ticket has no utxo history, so payouts to it land in escrow until a "marble" tenure clock passes — honest agents grow, clones stay frozen. Seed extensions ("opal") are sold one per real-world month per operator, so 500 clones cost 500 months of waiting, not one script run.
